item.title: Congratulations to the Class of 2025
item.dc:creator: muaz@astraldigit.com
item.content:encoded:
our graduates Teo Di Yang and Nordalila Husna.

Graduation and Awards Evening (GAE) 2025 was a proud moment for the entire ISK community. We also celebrate our Elementary, Middle, and High School award recipients, as well as the staff members who were recognized for their contributions and dedication.

Our heartfelt thanks to Executive Director Dr. Nurita binti Abu Tahir for leading the event with vision and care, and to all our teachers, staff, performers, and guests whose support made this celebration truly special.

Together, we honoured achievements, memories, and the bright road ahead.
